passages.note: Assembly Floor concurrence vote on SB 100; Kalra listed among the Ayes, 44-33.

passages.provision_quote: the procurement of electricity products from eligible renewable energy resources achieves 25 percent of retail sales by December 31, 2016, 33 percent by December 31, 2020, 44 percent by December 31, 2024, 52 percent by December 31, 2027, and 60 percent by December 31, 2030.
passages.note: Enacted SB 100 text mandates escalating RPS procurement to 60% by 2030 on a fixed schedule, a firm-deadline mandate.

rows.reasoning: Kalra voted Aye on the Assembly Floor concurrence vote (44-33) for SB 100 (2017-2018), a single-subject renewable-energy bill. Its enacted text requires retail sellers to achieve 44 percent by December 31, 2024, 52 percent by December 31, 2027, and 60 percent by December 31, 2030, a mandate with firm deadlines matching 'Require a shift to clean energy through mandates and firm deadlines.'
